title: E-FRC-0300: explores whether the fully frustrated Z3 centre flux cf0 keeps chiral wall members that its bulk levels...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0300 in the gauge arena: explores whether the fully frustrated Z3 centre flux cf0 keeps chiral wall members that its bulk levels only pushed out of the window: a Laughlin pump of one colour-singlet flux quantum and a closed x2 twist counts the wall levels crossing pi, an index no box size can fake.
